title: Boundary-valid GetVariableAccessAttributes with long-form BER length
purpose: Exercise a confirmed service with a valid long-form BER length and a short nested object-name-like payload so mutations can explore length handling without starting from malformed input.
expected_behavior: A BER/MMS parser should accept the long-form outer length, decode invoke id 1, and dispatch confirmed service tag [6] GetVariableAccessAttributes with a visible-string argument body.
constraints_preserved: Outer MMS PDU tag is 0xa0 Confirmed-Request-PDU.
Outer length uses valid BER long-form encoding 81 10 for 16 bytes of content.
Confirmed service tag [6] is encoded as 0xa6.
Inner visible string length matches the supplied content bytes.
issue_safety_notes: This seed avoids malformed or oversized boundary lengths and instead uses a valid long-form BER encoding suitable for safe mutation.
